question: Does the publicly downloadable 16mm VISION3 7207/7219 contact sheet expose enough exact condition and pairing structure to justify a separate bounded pixel audit?

source_page.title: Kodak 16mm Stock & Filtration Test
source_page.author: PeterPascucci
observed_facts: contains interior and exterior daylight conditions
contains overexposure, underexposure and multiple filter tests
offers downloadable high-resolution stills and a contact sheet

rights.allowed_use: local quarantined internal research source audit only

forbidden: download JPEG, TIFF or video payloads before this source gate passes
infer stock, exposure, filter, scene, process or scanner roles from visual appearance alone
treat a downloadable link as redistribution or commercial-product permission
fit an operator, train a model or score photographic transfer in this leaf
claim same scanner/process or independent stock response unless the contact sheet states it

branch_rule.pass: Open a separately frozen bounded integrity and role audit over the minimum sufficient TIFF rows.
branch_rule.fail: Close this exact public source before still-image download and seek another controlled observation.

claim_ceiling: Public source and contact-sheet role evidence for one author-run 16mm comparison; not pixel integrity, paired operator, process/scanner calibration, stock response or product evidence.
